dealerNetBills.calculation: Published signed net Wednesday position in USD millions / 1000; multi-component maturity buckets sum only complete same-date inputs.
dealerNetBills.coverageNote: Signed net primary-dealer position stock at fair value on Wednesday; published USD millions divided by 1000. SBN2024 regime only, from 2024-07-03.
